The titles move between political essay, literary fiction and documentary narrative, always precise and always restless.

js.faq.q: What is the free member area?
js.faq.r: It’s your personal space at Três Trevo. You create it with just your email — no password and no card — and use it to read a public-domain classic in our reader.
Great classics of English literature that are in the public domain. You choose one from the shelf in your member area.

js.faq.q: Why one classic at a time?
js.faq.r: Your free membership includes one reading space. When you finish a book, tap “Finish and switch” and choose the next one.

js.faq.q: Does it work on my phone?
js.faq.r: Yes. The reader adapts to any screen, with large type, night mode and your place saved wherever you stop.

js.faq.q: Are your own books available in English?
js.faq.r: Not yet. Our English editions are on their way, and they will appear in your member area as soon as they are published.
Our loyalty program. Once our English editions arrive, 10% of every purchase comes back as Nema, which becomes a discount on your next book. The full rules are on the Nema page.

priv.base: Performance of our agreement with you (account, purchases and reading), compliance with legal obligations (tax records), your consent (news emails and measurement cookies) and legitimate interest (site security).
priv.coleta: Your name and email when you create your member area or make a purchase; purchase details (product, amount and payment status), handled by the payment provider; your reading progress and the books you choose; and browsing data (pages visited and where the visit came from), through measurement cookies.
priv.compartilha: Only with the services the site needs to work: hosting and database (Supabase, Cloudflare and GitHub), payments (Mercado Pago), email delivery and audience measurement (Google Analytics and Meta). We do not sell your data.
priv.cookies: Google Analytics and the Meta pixel are only turned on after you click "Accept" in the cookie notice. If you decline, the site works normally, without those cookies. You can change your choice at any time: review my choice.
priv.direitos: You can ask to access, correct, port or delete your data, find out who it was shared with, and withdraw your consent, under Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD). If you are in the European Union, you also have your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Write to sac@3trevo.com.br.
priv.guarda: For as long as your account exists. Purchase records are kept for the period required by tax law. If you ask us to delete your account, we erase everything else.
priv.mudancas: If this policy changes, the new version is published on this page with its update date.
priv.quem: Três Trevo Publishing (Brazilian company ID 18.928.966/0001-59, Montauri, RS, Brazil) is the controller of the personal data processed on this site. Data protection contact: sac@3trevo.com.br.
priv.seguranca: You sign in through a link sent to your email, so we never store a password, and your data travels over an encrypted connection.
priv.titulo: How we look after your data
priv.uso: To create and keep your account, give you access to what you bought or chose, remember where you stopped reading, calculate your Nema balance, handle support and refund requests, and understand which pages work best. We only send news by email if you agree, and you can unsubscribe at any time through the link in the email itself.
sobre.autores.texto: We are open to acquiring publishing rights.
sobre.label: About us
sobre.p1: Três Trevo was born with a simple, direct purpose: to publish what matters. Literature that provokes, knowledge that transforms, writing that respects the reader’s intelligence.
sobre.p2: We are an independent digital publisher based in Montauri, in southern Brazil. Our model connects author and reader directly — no middlemen watering down the value of the work.
sobre.p3: With Nema, part of every purchase comes back to you as a discount on your next book.
